```{r}
# library(geomtextpath)
ggplot() +
  # Raw data — light grey points
    geom_point(
    data = xylem_Dh_genus |> dplyr::select(-family),
    aes(x = genus_mean_MAP + diff_from_genus_MAP, y = log_Dh),
    colour = "grey90", size = 1, alpha = 1
  ) +
  # Across-genus line — black, same in every facet
  geom_line(
    data = as_tibble(Dh_across_pred),
    aes(x = x, y = predicted),
    colour = "black", linewidth = 1.5, inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  # Selected family points — coloured
 geom_point(
    data = xylem_Dh_genus |> filter(family %in% selected_genera$family & !genus %in% selected_genera$genus),
    aes(x = genus_mean_MAP + diff_from_genus_MAP, y = log_Dh), col = "grey50", size = 0.5, alpha = 1
  ) +
  # Family-level lines — coloured (intercept shifts only, parallel slopes)
  geom_line(
    data = as_tibble(Dh_family_pred |> filter(group %in% selected_genera$family)) %>% rename(family = group),
    aes(x = x, y = predicted),
    col = "red", linewidth = 0.75, inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  # Selected genus points — coloured
 geom_point(
    data = xylem_Dh_genus |> filter(genus %in% selected_genera$genus),
    aes(x = genus_mean_MAP + diff_from_genus_MAP, y = log_Dh,
    colour = genus), size = 0.5, alpha = 1
  ) +
  # # Within-genus lines — coloured, scaled to global x-axis
  geom_labelline(
    data = Dh_within_pred_scaled |> filter(genus %in% selected_genera$genus),
    aes(x = x_scaled, y = predicted, label = genus, colour = genus),
    size = 1.75, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5,
    linetype = 2, boxlinewidth = 0.1,
    label.padding = unit(0.1, "lines")
  ) +
  # Facet by genus
  facet_wrap(~ family, scales = "fixed") +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = Dh_y_breaks,
    labels = \(x) round(exp(x), 1),
    name = D[h]~" (μm)"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = Dh_x_breaks,
    labels = \(x) round(exp(x), 0),
    name = "Mean Annual Precipitation (mm)"
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = selected_genera$color) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = selected_genera$color) +
  labs(
    # colour = "Genus",
    # title = "Hydraulic diameter ~ MAP", 
    # subtitle = "Black = across-genus effect | Colour = within-genus effect"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  ) -> Dh_genus_test
```

```{r}
# ── 5. Plot ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ggplot() +
  # Raw data — light grey points
    geom_point(
    data = xylem_Dh_genus |> dplyr::select(-genus, -family),
    aes(x = genus_mean_MAP + diff_from_genus_MAP, y = log_Dh),
    colour = "grey80", size = 1, alpha = 0.5
  ) +
  # Across-genus line — black, same in every facet
  geom_line(
    data = as_tibble(Dh_across_pred),
    aes(x = x, y = predicted),
    colour = "black", linewidth = 1.5, inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  # # Average within-genus response — dashed black line
  # geom_line(
  #   data = Dh_avg_within_scaled,
  #   aes(x = x_scaled, y = predicted),
  #   colour = "#575757", linewidth = 2, linetype = "dotted", inherit.aes = FALSE
  # ) +
  # Selected genus points — coloured
 geom_point(
    data = xylem_Dh_genus |> filter(genus %in% selected_genera$genus),
    aes(x = genus_mean_MAP + diff_from_genus_MAP, y = log_Dh,
    colour = genus), size = 2, alpha = 1, shape = 1
  ) +
  # Within-genus lines — coloured, scaled to global x-axis
  geom_ribbon(
    data = Dh_within_pred_scaled |> filter(genus %in% selected_genera$genus),
    aes(x = x_scaled, ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high, fill = genus),
    alpha = 0.2, inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = Dh_within_pred_scaled |> filter(genus %in% selected_genera$genus),
    aes(x = x_scaled, y = predicted, colour = genus),
    linewidth = 0.9, inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  # Family-level lines — coloured (intercept shifts only, parallel slopes)
  geom_line(
    data = as_tibble(Dh_family_pred |> filter(genus %in% selected_genera$genus)) %>% rename(family = group),
    aes(x = x, y = predicted), col = "red",
    linewidth = 0.5, linetype= "dashed", inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  # Facet by genus
  facet_wrap(~ genus, scales = "fixed") +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = Dh_y_breaks,
    labels = \(x) round(exp(x), 1),
    name = "Dh (μm)"
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = genus_colours$color) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = genus_colours$color) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = Dh_x_breaks,
    labels = \(x) round(exp(x), 0),
    name = "Mean Annual Precipitation (mm)"
  ) +

  labs(
    colour = "Genus", fill = "Genus",
    # title = "Hydraulic diameter ~ MAP",
    # subtitle = "Black = across-genus effect | Colour = within-genus effect"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95")
  ) -> Dh_genus_facet_family
```

```{r}
# ── Plot ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ggplot() +
  # Raw data
  geom_point(
    data = xylem_Dh_genus,
    aes(x = genus_mean_MAP + diff_from_genus_MAP, y = log_Dh),
    colour = "grey80", size = 1, alpha = 0.5
  ) +
  # Across-genus line — black
  geom_ribbon(
    data = as_tibble(across_pred),
    aes(x = x, ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high),
    fill = "black", alpha = 0.15, inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = as_tibble(across_pred),
    aes(x = x, y = predicted),
    colour = "black", linewidth = 1, inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  # Average within-genus — dashed black
  geom_ribbon(
    data = avg_within_scaled,
    aes(x = x_scaled, ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high),
    fill = "black", alpha = 0.10, inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = avg_within_scaled,
    aes(x = x_scaled, y = predicted),
    colour = "black", linewidth = 1, linetype = "dashed", inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  # Within-genus lines — coloured by genus
  geom_ribbon(
    data = within_pred_scaled,
    aes(x = x_scaled, ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high, fill = genus),
    alpha = 0.2, inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = within_pred_scaled,
    aes(x = x_scaled, y = predicted, colour = genus),
    linewidth = 0.9, inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  # Genus labels
  geom_text(
    data = genus_labels,
    aes(x = x_scaled, y = predicted, label = genus, colour = genus),
    hjust = -0.1, vjust = 0, size = 3, fontface = "italic",
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ family, scales = "fixed") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = genus_colours) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = genus_colours) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = y_breaks,
    labels = \(x) round(exp(x), 1),
    name = "Dh (μm)"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = x_breaks,
    labels = \(x) round(exp(x), 0),
    name = "Mean Annual Precipitation (mm)"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Hydraulic diameter ~ MAP",
    subtitle = "Solid black = across-genus | Dashed black = avg within-genus | Colour = genus"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "italic")
  )
```

```{r}
library(ggh4x)

# Create genus factor ordered by family (then genus within family)
genus_order <- xylem_Dh_genus %>%
  distinct(genus, family) %>%
  arrange(family, genus) %>%
  pull(genus)

xylem_Dh_genus <- xylem_Dh_genus %>%
  mutate(genus = factor(genus, levels = genus_order))

# Replace facet_wrap with nested facet
ggplot() +
  # Raw data — light grey points
    geom_point(
    data = xylem_Dh_genus |> dplyr::select(-genus, -family),
    aes(x = genus_mean_MAP + diff_from_genus_MAP, y = log_Dh),
    colour = "grey90", size = 1, alpha = 1
  ) +
  # Across-genus line — black, same in every facet
  geom_line(
    data = as_tibble(Dh_across_pred),
    aes(x = x, y = predicted),
    colour = "black", linewidth = 1.5, inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  # # Family-level lines — coloured (intercept shifts only, parallel slopes)
  # geom_line(
  #   data = as_tibble(Dh_family_pred |> filter(group %in% selected_genera$family)),
  #   aes(x = x, y = predicted), col = "red",
  #   linewidth = 0.9, inherit.aes = FALSE,
  #   linetype = 2
  # ) +
  # Selected genus points — coloured
 geom_point(
    data = xylem_Dh_genus |> filter(genus %in% selected_genera$genus),
    aes(x = genus_mean_MAP + diff_from_genus_MAP, y = log_Dh,
    colour = genus), size = 0.5, alpha = 1
  ) +
  # Within-genus lines — coloured, scaled to global x-axis
  geom_ribbon(
    data = Dh_within_pred_scaled |> filter(genus %in% selected_genera$genus),
    aes(x = x_scaled, ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high, fill = genus),
    alpha = 0.2, inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = Dh_within_pred_scaled |> filter(genus %in% selected_genera$genus),
    aes(x = x_scaled, y = predicted, colour = genus),
    linewidth = 0.9, inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linetype = 2
  ) +
  # Facet by genus
  facet_nested_wrap(~ family + genus, 
               nest_line = element_line(linetype = 2),
               solo_line = TRUE) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = Dh_y_breaks,
    labels = \(x) round(exp(x), 1),
    name = "Dh (μm)"
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = genus_colours$color) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = genus_colours$color) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = Dh_x_breaks,
    labels = \(x) round(exp(x), 0),
    name = "Mean Annual Precipitation (mm)"
  ) +
  labs(
    colour = "Genus", fill = "Genus",
    # title = "Hydraulic diameter ~ MAP",
    # subtitle = "Black = across-genus effect | Colour = within-genus effect"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "italic")
  )
```
